questions: Measure success per validated cost, first-pass success, latency, retries and handoff overhead.
Separate replay estimates from real-run evidence; test unknown costs and failure censoring.
decision: Strengthen telemetry and evaluation so savings mean lower total cost per validated outcome, not prettier replay statistics.
code_observations: routing_telemetry whitelists fields and represents absent usage as null. Its inspected _number helper rejects negative/non-numeric values but does not explicitly reject positive infinity.
The benchmark replays a fixed corpus and can repeat its records. Deterministic repetitions are not independent new real-world samples.
Existing routing evaluation has separate acceptance gates and shadow/candidate concepts; preserve them rather than enabling learned selection from one synthetic success.
implementation_steps: Reject NaN/infinite usage, latency and prices at all ingestion/aggregation seams; serialize strict JSON and retain unknown as null, not zero.
Attribute costs by actual backend/profile, worker kind and attempt. Include failed attempts, reviewers, handoffs and advisory calls in the denominator calculation.
Report unique tasks/cases separately from replay repetitions and real authenticated attempts. Do not use repeated identical fixture rows to narrow confidence intervals as though new evidence existed.
Predeclare acceptance, regression margins, workload strata, warm/cold cache conditions and abort criteria before collecting candidate results.
Enable automatic selection only after representative held-out outcome evaluation. Keep shadow evaluation and deterministic fallback available on sparse or stale evidence.
proposed_acceptance_tests: Non-finite numbers cannot produce a successful numeric rollup or invalid JSON.
Missing cost remains unknown and is not silently compared as free.
Failed attempts and diagnostic/handoff costs are included in cost per validated result.
Repeating a fixed corpus changes replay count but not the claimed independent sample count.
A candidate with lower apparent cost but worse critical acceptance cannot pass the quality gate.

alternatives.title: Optimize input tokens or synthetic pass rate alone
alternatives.tradeoff: Simple but ignores retries, reviewer cost and weak validation.

alternatives.title: Native-unit complete accounting and unique-case evaluation
alternatives.tradeoff: Makes the economic claim falsifiable without forcing a universal price model.

alternatives.title: Train and enable a learned router immediately
alternatives.tradeoff: Sparse workload evidence can under-route important tasks while looking economical.

cost_model: Use total observed cost divided by validated outcomes, with separate API cash, credits and unpriced usage. Report latency and quality alongside cost; replay estimates are explicitly not live savings.
unverified: No new paid model benchmark was performed. Literature improvements are not transferable percentages and current account pricing was not measured.
runtime_experiments: No authenticated model calls; tests listed here are implementation obligations, not claimed passes.
